description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for tracking the user's location and displaying it on a Google Map within the application. It includes functionality to obtain the current geographic position, initialize and display a Google Map centered on that location, and manage map state.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays the user's current location on a Google Map with tracking functionality.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget, returning an instance of _LocationState.

methods.name: _LocationState
methods.description: State class managing the location tracking, map initialization, and UI for the Location widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state, fetches user's current location asynchronously, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, showing either a loading message or the Google Map centered on current location.

methods.name: onMapCreated
methods.description: Callback to handle the Google Map's creation and store the map controller.
